subject: EXCH
title: Exchange Program College of Systems and Society (Band 1)
summary: Students enrol in this course when they have been approved to participate in a formal exchange with one of the Australian National University's overseas exchange partners.
description:
Students enrol in this course when they have been approved to participate in a formal exchange with one of the Australian National University's overseas exchange partners.

For information regarding exchanges, selection criteria, etc, please go to the following website: Student exchange | ANU College of Systems & Society

Band 1 courses include Agriculture, Forestry, English, mathematics, education, clinical psychology, languages.
